title: Great Elm Capital Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Great Elm Capital Corp. filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026, announcing its exercise of an option to redeem in whole its 5.875% Notes due 2026 (CUSIP 390320 604, NASDAQ: GECCO) on May 27, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest.
key_points: Great Elm Capital Corp. exercising redemption option for 5.875% Notes due 2026 (CUSIP 390320 604, ticker GECCO)
Notes will be redeemed at 100% of principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest
Announcement made pursuant to Section 1104 of the Indenture dated September 18, 2017, with trustee Equiniti Trust Company, LLC
This filing covers multiple securities (common stock and four note series) but only the 2026 notes are subject to redemption
Filing date and event date both April 27, 2026
